title: Integrate paid-claim and bank evidence checks without automatic payment writes
public_pr_body:
Merge #176 (reconciled paid-claim adapter) and #177 (reconciled bank parser) on top of the combined chase branch (#208). Both merge cleanly without conflict or source behavior changes.

Add one end-to-end unit flow per input: a fake email through the detector/adapter to a review flag, and a fake bank CSV through parsing/matching to its flagged invoice. Frozen invoice rows retain sent status, zero paid amount and the exact 12050-pence balance; spoofed sender evidence is refused. Evidence never automatically records a payment. Fixtures use fictional example.test addresses only.

Base: codex/chase-layout-main. Unit coverage proves review suggestions, not real database claim persistence; the existing explicit human confirmation/RPC path remains separate. No docs changes, SQL or real data.

Validation: paid-claim/bank integration unit suites, typecheck and targeted ESLint run. Live inbox/bank UI, database persistence and actual bank/mail services are not run.
